sources.title: 国家中小学智慧教育平台 · 电子教材（闽教版英语三年级起点，三上至六下 8 册，目录页为准）

units.title: Unit 1 Meeting Friends
lessons: 话题：问候与自我介绍
句型：Nice to meet you. / What's your name, please? My name is Li Li. / How are you? I'm fine. Thank you.
课文：Lesson 1 Nice to meet you. / Lesson 2 What's your name, please? / Lesson 3 How are you? / Lesson 4 Have a good day!

units.title: Unit 2 Fun Numbers
lessons: 话题：数字、年龄、电话号码
句型：How many ducks? / How old are you? I'm five years old. / What's your phone number? It's 81726953.
课文：Lesson 1 Let's play! / Lesson 2 How many ducks? / Lesson 3 How old are you? / Lesson 4 What's your phone number?

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Colors Around Us
lessons: 话题：颜色、文具
句型：What color is it? It's pink. / Show me red, please. My schoolbag is red. / They are colorful flowers.
课文：Lesson 1 It's green. / Lesson 2 What color is it? / Lesson 3 Show me red, please. / Lesson 4 They are colorful flowers.

units.title: Unit 4 Loving My Family
lessons: 话题：家庭成员与职业
句型：This is my father. / Who is he? He is my grandpa. / Who are they? They are my sister and brother.
课文：Lesson 1 This is my father. / Lesson 2 Who is he? / Lesson 3 Who are they? / Lesson 4 I love my family.

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 3–4

units.title: Unit 1 Our Animal Friends
lessons: 话题：动物
句型：This is a bear. It's big. / These are pandas. Those are horses. / Is it a rabbit? Yes, it is. No, it isn't.
课文：Lesson 1 This is a bear. / Lesson 2 These are pandas. / Lesson 3 I have an animal friend. / Lesson 4 Look! It's a cat.

units.title: Unit 2 My Clothes
lessons: 话题：衣物、尺码、物品位置
句型：What size do you wear? Size S. / Whose shirt is this? It's Yang Ming's shirt. / Where is my sweater? Is it on your bed?
课文：Lesson 1 What size do you wear? / Lesson 2 Whose shirt is this? / Lesson 3 Where is my sweater? / Lesson 4 Put on your sports shoes.

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Time
lessons: 话题：钟点、时差、日常活动
句型：It's eleven o'clock in Beijing. / What's the time in New York? It's 7:30 p.m. / What are you doing? I'm cooking. / It's time to do my homework.
课文：Lesson 1 It's eleven o'clock in Beijing. / Lesson 2 What's the time in New York? / Lesson 3 It's five twenty. / Lesson 4 It's time to do my homework.

units.title: Unit 4 Healthy Eating
lessons: 话题：早餐、饮料、晚餐、健康饮食
句型：What do you like for breakfast? I like eggs and noodles. / What do you want to eat? / What's your favorite drink? My favorite drink is milk.
课文：Lesson 1 What do you like for breakfast? / Lesson 2 Do you want some apple juice? / Lesson 3 What's your favorite drink? / Lesson 4 What's for dinner?

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 3–4

units.title: Unit 1 Our School
lessons: 话题：校园设施、班级、教室
句型：We can play sports there. / Which class are you in? I'm in Class One, Grade Four. / Look at the windows. They are clean and bright.
课文：Lesson 1 We can play sports there. / Lesson 2 Which class are you in? / Lesson 3 Look at the blackboard. / Lesson 4 I love my school.

units.title: Unit 2 Daily Life
lessons: 话题：作息时间、家务、运动
句型：When do you get up? I get up at 7:30 a.m. / Li Li gets up at 7:20 a.m. She has breakfast at 7:40 a.m. / I can pick up the toys.
课文：Lesson 1 I get up at 7:30 a.m. / Lesson 2 She has breakfast at 7:40 a.m. / Lesson 3 I can sweep the floor. / Lesson 4 I often run on the sports ground.

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Our Hobbies
lessons: 话题：爱好
句型：What's your hobby? My hobby is drawing. / What do you like doing? I like watching birds. / I can learn a lot from the books.
课文：Lesson 1 What's your hobby? / Lesson 2 We have new hobbies in China. / Lesson 3 What do you like doing? / Lesson 4 I have many hobbies.

units.title: Unit 4 Chinese Festivals
lessons: 话题：中国传统节日
句型：What's the Spring Festival? It's Chinese New Year. / What do you do on the Lantern Festival? We guess lantern riddles. / My favorite festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival.
课文：Lesson 1 The Spring Festival is coming. / Lesson 2 We have a big family dinner together. / Lesson 3 We guess lantern riddles. / Lesson 4 We have many festivals in China.

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 3–4

units.title: Unit 1 Weekly Activities
lessons: 话题：星期、课外活动、周末计划
句型：What day is it today? It's Monday. / What do you often do after school on weekdays? / What do you want to do on Saturday? I want to go to the park.
课文：Lesson 1 There are seven days in a week. / Lesson 2 I often play football on Monday. / Lesson 3 Friday is our cleaning day. / Lesson 4 What do you want to do on Saturday?

units.title: Unit 2 My Favorite Subject
lessons: 话题：学科、学校生活
句型：What classes do we have on Monday? / Do you like math? / What's your favorite subject? My favorite subject is IT.
课文：Lesson 1 What classes do we have on Monday? / Lesson 2 My favorite subject is music. / Lesson 3 Our school life is interesting. / Lesson 4 IT class is very useful.

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Our Feelings
lessons: 话题：情绪与感受
句型：How do you feel? I'm tired but excited. / He looks tired. Are you all right? No, I'm sad. / I'm bored. I feel lonely.
课文：Lesson 1 I'm tired but excited. / Lesson 2 You can do better next time. / Lesson 3 You have many ways to be happy. / Lesson 4 I'm not a poor duckling.

units.title: Unit 4 Getting Around
lessons: 话题：交通方式、出行
句型：How do you go to school? I go to school by school bus. / How does your mother go to work? She goes to work by bike. / What will you do in summer holiday? I'll fly to London.
课文：Lesson 1 How do you go to school? / Lesson 2 How does your mother go to work? / Lesson 3 Traveling by train is cheap. / Lesson 4 I'll fly to London.

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 3–4

units.title: Unit 1 Weather in Different Seasons
lessons: 话题：季节与天气
句型：What season is it? It's summer. / How is the weather in Moscow? It's cloudy and snowy. / It gets warm. They take off their coats.
课文：Lesson 1 There are four seasons in a year. / Lesson 2 How is the weather in Moscow? / Lesson 3 Seasons are colorful. / Lesson 4 The weather in London changes a lot.

units.title: Unit 2 Months of the Year
lessons: 话题：月份、节假日
句型：It's hot in June, July and August. / It's December. Because I can go skating in December. / New Year's Day is in January.
课文：Lesson 1 I'm going to Mount Wuyi in October. / Lesson 2 What's your favorite month? / Lesson 3 We fly to warm places for our winter. / Lesson 4 New Year's Day is in January.

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Plans and Dates
lessons: 话题：日期、计划
句型：What's the date today? It's May 29. / I'll make some red paper flowers for Mom. / On October 2, we'll visit the West Lake.
课文：Lesson 1 What's the date today? / Lesson 2 Tomorrow is Mother's Day. / Lesson 3 Let's help the lost pets. / Lesson 4 We'll go to Hangzhou for holiday.

units.title: Unit 4 Our Dream Jobs
lessons: 话题：职业与理想
句型：What does he do? He's a fireman. / What do you want to be? I want to be a football player. / Miss Gao is an English teacher. She is kind to her students.
课文：Lesson 1 What does he do? / Lesson 2 What do you want to be? / Lesson 3 She works in a school. / Lesson 4 I want to be a storyteller.

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 3–4

units.title: Unit 1 Winter Vacation
lessons: 话题：寒假经历
句型（概括）：Where did you go for your winter vacation? I went to … / How was your winter vacation?

units.title: Unit 2 A Visit to the Zoo
lessons: 话题：参观动物园
句型（概括）：What animals did you see at the zoo? I saw …

units.title: Unit 3 Zhong Nanshan
lessons: 话题：人物介绍（钟南山）
句型（概括）：Who is he? He is a doctor. / 介绍人物经历与品质

units.title: Unit 4 A Spring Outing
lessons: 话题：春游
句型（概括）：We are going to have a spring outing. / What are you going to take?

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–4

units.title: Unit 5 Sports Day
lessons: 话题：运动会
句型（概括）：What are you going to do on Sports Day? / 谈论运动项目与比赛

units.title: Unit 6 Feelings
lessons: 话题：情绪与感受
句型（概括）：How do you feel? I feel … / Why? Because …

units.title: Unit 7 Tall Buildings
lessons: 话题：建筑、比较
句型（概括）：描述和比较建筑物（高度、大小）

units.title: Unit 8 Dates of the Month
lessons: 话题：日期、序数词
句型（概括）：What's the date today? / When is your birthday?

units.title: Review 2
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 5–8

units.title: Unit 1 Wonderful Sports Events
lessons: 话题：体育运动、奥运会、全民健身日
句型：Will you join the football team? Yes, I will. / No, I won't. / The Games began on February 4, 2022. / August 8 became our National Fitness Day.

课文：Lesson 1 Will you join the football team? / Lesson 2 What do you know about the Olympic Games? / Lesson 3 China hosted the 24th Winter Olympic Games. / Lesson 4 National Fitness Day is on August 8.

units.title: Unit 2 Healthy Life
lessons: 话题：健康饮食、看病、锻炼
句型：Which menu do you like? Why do you like it? / What's the matter with you? I have a headache. / He does exercise every day. / First, eat healthy food.
课文：Lesson 1 I have rice, fish and vegetables for lunch. / Lesson 2 What's the matter with you? / Lesson 3 Doing exercise is good for our health. / Lesson 4 How can we keep healthy?

units.title: Review 1
lessons: 话题：复习 Unit 1–2

units.title: Unit 3 Good Manners
lessons: 话题：礼仪（做客、学校、公共场所、餐桌）
句型：Take a seat, please. Have a cup of tea, please. / We always say "please" and "thank you". / Don't stand on the swing. Don't cut in line.
课文：Lesson 1 Make yourself at home. / Lesson 2 We should have good manners at school. / Lesson 3 We have good manners in public. / Lesson 4 Let's enjoy food with good table manners!

units.title: Unit 4 Great People
lessons: 话题：伟人与普通劳动者
句型：Why do you like Yuan Longping? Because he was hardworking. / What do you know about him? He's a physicist. / Marie Curie was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize.
课文：Lesson 1 Let's talk about the great people of China. / Lesson 2 Let's read a book about great people. / Lesson 3 Let's learn about some great women. / Lesson 4 Everyone can be great.

lessons: 话题：寒假活动
句型（概括）：Did you go anywhere in winter? / What did you do in winter?

units.title: Unit 2 Helping Each Other
lessons: 话题：互相帮助

lessons: 话题：看病

句型（概括）：What do you want to be? I want to be … / Why? Because …

lessons: 话题：参观中学
句型（概括）：描述中学的设施与生活

lessons: 话题：毕业告别
